E-stim safety agreement

Anubis is not a medical device. Electric stimulation can cause serious injury or death if misused. You must read and accept every item.

Before you start

Start at the lowest strength and increase slowly so you can feel how it lands.

Keep electrodes below the waist and off the chest. Don't use this with a pacemaker or other implanted device, or on broken or irritated skin, and don't use it in water, while driving or operating machinery, or while you're asleep.

The gold STOP button, or a press of either Coyote dial, cuts output immediately.

Tutorial mode

Tutorial mode shows a short tip the first time you open each screen. Start with it or without it?

Change it any time: ⚙ Settings → Appearance → Tutorial → Tutorial mode.

Device reconnected

Audio settings
Channel & gain
Audio channel
A
B
Which side of the sound feeds each channel. Mono is the average of left and right.
Mic is mono only: A and B both use the mono signal.
Not used for .hwl files: they drive A and B directly.
Gain
AutoThe leveler sets the gain from how loud the sound is. Touch the slider to take over.
Gain is applied first, ahead of the equalizer and everything after it (like a preamp). ±12 dB.
Equalizer · both channels
60 Hz
250 Hz
1 kHz
4 kHz
12 kHz
One EQ for A and B, applied after Gain and before the level is measured. Bass, Mid and High lift that range and pull the rest down; moving a slider switches to Custom, which keeps your own curve. The bars above show the band levels after the EQ.
Output levels, mute & swap
Output levels
Start level
Floor
Max step up
Smoothing
Max output is the dial slider: set it to the loudest level you want and the audio is scaled to land its peaks there (move it any time; raises ease in with soft start, drops are instant). Start level: where the output begins when the sound kicks in (it is not a hard floor). Floor: the lowest output while audio plays, 0 = it may fall silent between hits; never above Start level or the slider. Max step up limits how fast the output may rise (Off = no limit). Smoothing softens attack and release. Max Output, soft start and device limits still apply.
Mute on silenceOutput 0 after a quarter-second of silence
Swap A ⇄ BWhat is computed for A goes out on B and the other way round. Max Output, soft start and the device limit stay with the physical channel.
Dynamics
Sensitivity
Dynamic range
Contrast
Beat ↔ envelope
Attack
Release
Headroom
Dynamic range is how many dB of loudness map onto 0–100%: a small range follows every wiggle, a large one flattens. Contrast above 100% pushes quiet parts down and loud parts up. Beat ↔ envelope: 0% follows the continuous loudness, 100% only the beat onsets. The output is updated every 25 ms (the Coyote's slot rate) and holds each 100 ms frame's peak, so beats still punch; Smoothing (in Output levels) stretches attack and release together.

Unlock Max Output above 100?
Levels above 100 can be uncomfortable or unsafe, especially on a fast ramp. Anubis is not a medical device. STOP, soft start and your Max Output still apply, and you can lock this again in Settings.


Reset all colors?
Every color goes back to the original theme. This cannot be undone.

Advanced / Troubleshoot ›




Pairing mode (required after DG firmware 4.0)


  1. Close the official DG-LAB app completely.
  2. Power on the Coyote box.
  3. Pull both dials DOWN and hold until the shoulder lights flash yellow ↔ blue, then release.
  4. Tap Rescan below. Keep the dials held if it still won't appear.
  5. On Samsung: turn Location ON in system settings (scan results stay empty if it is off).

Listen to this phone's audio?
Android asks permission to listen to your phone's audio; nothing is recorded or shown. Only loudness levels are used, for this session. If Android's box mentions screen sharing or recording, that is just its standard wording. Pick the option that allows it.

Show Anubis over other apps?
Android needs your OK to show the small output + STOP bubble while you use other apps. Tap Continue, find Anubis in the list, switch on “Allow display over other apps”, then press Back. Sessions keep running without it.
